themes.demarquage: Getting free and calling for the ball
themes.contre-attaque: Fast break and moving the ball up

attaque-15.intention: Against a 5-1, the back line stays on the 6 m line and only one defender steps out. We look to exploit the space in front of that line and behind the front defender.
principes: Build up speed before receiving the ball to attack the line on the move.
Draw the front defender to free a teammate behind him.
Spread the play wide to stretch the line of five and open the gaps.
Dare to shoot from distance: the 5-1 often leaves room for the backs.
age: No opposing 5-1 at this age: we mainly play one-on-one and in the gaps.
Recognise the front defender and play behind him. Link the decision to shoot or pass to the defender's position.
Set up prepared moves (crosses, screens by the line player) and read whether the line of five steps out or drops back.

defense-15.intention: The 5-1 is a team defence: the front defender disrupts the ball circulation, the back five shift together and step out on the ball carrier at the right moment.
principes: The front defender bothers the centre back and cuts off the easy passes between the backs.
The back five shift together towards the ball, without leaving a hole.
Step out on the ball carrier, then get straight back into the line (out, back in).
Control the line player: always know who is taking him.
Talk constantly: call out crosses and player switches.
age: Too early for a 5-1: we defend by moving forward, often man-to-man, to learn to win the ball back.
We discover the 5-1 after deeper, staggered defences: the front defender's role, shifting, stepping out on the ball carrier.
Adapt the 5-1 to the opponent: front defender higher or lower, player switches, deterring the shooters.

demarquage.intention: Without the ball, every player must make himself useful: show himself, be seen and offer the ball carrier a safe passing option.
principes: Always move into free space, visible to the ball carrier.
Change pace and direction to get away from your defender.
Call for the ball (voice, hand out) at the right moment, not too early.
Receive on the move, facing the goal.
age: Run into empty spaces and call for the ball. Lots of small-sided play.
Get free with running feints and changes of pace, reading the defender's position.
Get free to serve a team move, keeping good spacing with teammates.

intervalle.intention: The gap is the space between two defenders. Attacking it forces the defence to make a choice, and it is the basis of all attacking play.
principes: Run towards the goal, between two defenders, rather than sideways.
Draw two defenders to free a teammate.
Pass before the contact, just as the defender commits.
If nobody comes, go all the way and shoot.
age: Play forward, between two opponents, with simple rules.
Make the right choice between shooting and passing depending on the defender's reaction.
Chain gap attacks at high speed to create an overload.

contre-attaque.intention: As soon as the ball is won, we attack before the opposing defence is set. Speed and running lanes make the difference.
principes: As soon as the ball is won, the goalkeeper and defenders restart quickly.
Run in lanes, spread wide, so as not to get in each other's way.
Build up speed before the ball arrives and watch the ball carrier while running.
Finish with an overload; if the chance isn't there, go straight into the second wave.
When the ball is lost, get back immediately: those on the fast break are also the first to defend.
age: Run and play forward as soon as we have the ball. It is the heart of the game at this age.
Organise the first wave (wings) and the second wave (backs), with a quick goalkeeper restart.
Link moving the ball up with the quick throw-off, manage getting back and the overload.

pivot.intention: The line player lives in the middle of the defence: he creates space for the backs and offers a passing option close to goal.
principes: The line player positions himself between two defenders, always moving.
He screens or blocks to free a back.
The pass to the line player must be safe: bounce pass, lob or into his run.
If the defence closes in on the line player, the backs shoot; if it steps out, we pass to the line player.
age: No fixed position: everyone plays line player to discover the game close to the goal area.
Learn screens and the pass to the line player in simple situations, in twos or threes.
Build the game around the line player: screens, rolls, combinations with the backs.

gardien.intention: The goalkeeper is the first attacker and the last defender. He stops shots, but he also directs his defence and launches the fast break.
principes: Stand on the line joining the ball to the middle of the goal, to narrow the shooting angle.
Stay balanced, on your toes, ready to go either way.
Read the shooter: his arm, his footing, where he looks.
Restart quickly after the save.
Talk to your defence: call out the shooter and the line player.
age: Everyone has a turn in goal, with small goals. We discover the position without fear of the ball.
Work on positioning, footwork and basic saves, always linking the save to the restart.
Read opposing shooters, work with the defence and analyse shots after matches.

duel-def.intention: Winning the defensive duel means stopping the attacker from going where he wants, then winning the ball, without a serious foul.
principes: Stay low on your feet, ready to move fast.
Move towards the attacker to bother him before he builds up speed.
Steer the attacker to the outside, where he is less dangerous.
Contact from the front, with the chest and arms, within the rules.
Keep one arm up to bother the shot and the pass.
age: Defend by moving forward to touch or win the ball, without dangerous contact.
Learn legal contact, steering the attacker and helping a teammate.
Win the duel while staying connected to the team: deter, help, recover.

jeux-jeunes.intention: In mini-handball, the game is the best teacher: lots of balls, lots of goals, and fun to make them want to come back.
principes: Play often and in small numbers so everyone touches the ball.
Simple rules, adapted as the game goes on.
Everyone plays every position, including goalkeeper.
Praise effort and boldness more than the result.
age: Games, movement skills and fun above all.
(Theme designed for mini-handball)
(Theme designed for mini-handball)

ui.subtitle: Plan your training session in 30 seconds, with tactical boards
ui.tipsIntro: Background ideas on motivation, youth development, principles of play and player health. Each article ends with practical points for your next session.
ui.aboutHtml:
About this prototype

Séances Hand helps coaches plan their training sessions. You choose a theme, an age group, a duration and the number of players present. The site then builds a progressive session: warm-up, drills, game situation and cool-down.

Each drill has its own animated tactical board. Press ▶ to see the movements step by step.

Reading the boards

  • Blue circles: attackers (LW, LB, CB, RB, RW, LP = line player).
  • Orange squares: defenders, numbered from the outside left towards the right (F = front defender).
  • Green circle: goalkeeper. Grey circle: fixed passer.
  • Solid line: a player's movement. Yellow dotted line: pass or shot.

Content

This is demonstration content. The drills are written from the principles of federation coach education and technical documents, then rewritten and redrawn. This translation was made from the French version. Before the public launch, every sheet will be reviewed by a coach.
ui.adaptBig: With {n} players: play {k} against {k} on half a court, without the wings.
ui.adaptSmall: With {n} players: reduce the number of groups and rotate faster.
ui.noTheme: This theme is not yet available for {c}. Try “{t}”.
ui.youngNote: Young players: use small goals (2.40 m x 1.70 m) and a 4 or 5 m goal area. Play small-sided, with the goalkeeper restarting immediately after each goal.
ui.philoBody:
Drills are useless without a clear idea of the game you want. Here are the main ideas behind the sessions on this site.

1. The game comes first

We learn handball by playing. Every session ends with a game situation, and the technical drills prepare for that moment. A drill should always look like a real match moment: a goal, opponents, choices to make.

2. Attacking means moving towards the goal

  • First look for the shortest way to the goal.
  • Draw a defender to create an overload elsewhere.
  • Play fast, but make the right choice: shoot, pass or keep the ball.

3. Defending means winning the ball back

  • We defend to win the ball back, not just to stop the goal.
  • We defend by moving forward and together, talking.
  • With young players, favour defences that move forward before systems lined up on the goal area.

4. Transitions win matches

The moment the ball changes hands is decisive. We restart quickly after winning the ball, and get back straight away after losing it.

5. The goalkeeper is part of the team

He defends with his teammates, directs them and launches the attack. He trains with the group, not on the side.

6. The coach's role

  • One or two instructions at a time, short and precise.
  • Ask questions rather than explaining everything: “Where was the free space?”
  • Let everyone play and praise progress.
  • Adapt the drill if it doesn't work: more space, fewer defenders, an extra rule.

7. A progression by age

    {AGES}

The themes one by one

Tap a theme to see its principles, key words and objectives by age.
philoAges: play, move, touch the ball a lot, discover every position and defend by moving forward.
learn to make choices, discover roles and staggered defences, then systems.
master systems, adapt to the opponent and become more efficient.
ui.philoNote: This text presents general principles of handball coaching, written for this site. It should be reviewed and completed by a coach.

w-rugby.objectif: Warm up by playing, working on availability and supporting the ball carrier.
orga: Two teams on the whole court, one ball.
No travelling rule: you run with the ball in your hands.
To score, place the ball on the floor in the opponents' goal area.
consignes: Touching the ball carrier is enough to win the ball.
Stay close to the ball carrier to give him a passing option.
variantes: Passes only backwards or level.
At least three passes before you can score.

w-huit.objectif: Link pass and support run, preparing for crosses.
orga: Groups of 3 across the width, one ball.
Out with passes, back running on the outside.
consignes: After each pass, run behind the receiver.
Take the ball on the run, throwing arm up high.
variantes: Finish with a shot at goal.
Bounce pass for the youngest players.
steps: The middle player passes left, then runs behind him.
The new ball carrier passes right and runs behind the receiver.
Keep going in a figure of eight up to the goal area, then shoot.
Shot at the end of the run.

w-cascade.objectif: Warm up the throwing arm and the goalkeeper with precise targets.
orga: Four lines (LW, LB, RB, RW), one ball per player.
Shots follow one another from one position to the next.
consignes: Respect the target called: near corner, then far corner.
Standing shot, then jump shot.
variantes: The goalkeeper announces his strong side: the shooter aims for the other.

r-7m.objectif: Finish with a calm challenge and work on concentration when shooting.
orga: The whole group in a line, a goalkeeper who changes every three attempts.
consignes: One miss and you're out. The last one in wins.

r-bilan.objectif: Recover and get players to put into words what they learned.
orga: In a circle: gentle stretching of the legs, shoulders and back.
consignes: Each player names one thing that worked and one to improve.

j-jeunes.objectif: Play a lot, touch the ball often, keep a fair contest between shooter and goalkeeper.
orga: Courts across the width, small goals (2.40 m x 1.70 m).
Goal area marked at 4 or 5 m depending on level.
After a goal, the goalkeeper restarts straight away from his area.
consignes: Everyone attacks and everyone defends.
One one-minute time-out per team per half.
variantes: For under-9s, 3+1 against 3+1 if space is tight.

a1.objectif: Move the ball fast and far to make the line of five run.
orga: Six positions filled, a goalkeeper, no defence.
One ball, then two when it flows.
consignes: Receive moving forward, shoulders turned to the goal.
The wings stay wide, close to the sideline.
Gradually speed up the passing.
variantes: Weighted ball to add arm strengthening.
Skip pass over the CB compulsory at every switch of play.
steps: The left wing passes to the LB, who takes the ball moving forward.
The LB moves it on to the CB, who steps up in turn.
The CB passes to the RB, who attacks the goal.
The RB plays wide to the right wing.
Back to the RB...
...who switches play with a skip pass over the CB.

a2.titre: Receive on the run and attack the goal
a2.objectif: Take the ball at speed, in line with the goal, to put the defence under pressure.
orga: Three lines of backs (LB, CB, RB), one ball per line, a goalkeeper.
The CB feeds the backs as they start towards the goal.
consignes: Start before the pass, not after.
First attack in line with the goal, then towards the inside.
After the shot, go back behind your line.
variantes: The passer becomes a contact defender: standing shot, then jump shot.
The backs change lines after each turn.
steps: The LB starts towards the goal and the CB passes into his run.
Standing shot or jump shot.
The LB goes back behind his line, the next one gets ready.

a3.titre: Draw the front defender, free the back
a3.objectif: Take the front defender out of play by drawing him, then exploit the overload.
orga: 2 against 1 in the centre (LB and RB against the front defender).
A blocking defender on 6 m, a fixed passer, a goalkeeper.
consignes: Attack towards the centre and receive on the run.
If the front defender steps up: draw him, then pass.
If the front defender stays: shoot.
variantes: The blocker may step out on the shooter: it becomes two against two.
steps: The LB moves inside and receives on the run.
The front defender steps up on him. The LB draws him, then passes to the RB, who has moved closer.
The RB shoots past the blocker.

a4.objectif: Turn the CB into a second line player to empty the centre of the defence.
orga: 4 against 3 in the centre: LB, CB, RB and line player against the front defender and two 6 m defenders.
Two wings as fixed passers, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The CB passes to a back, then runs in on the opposite side.
The line player shifts towards the ball.
Read the front defender: if he follows the CB, the back attacks the centre; if he stays, play with the CB.
variantes: Same thing on the right.
Add a third 6 m defender (4 against 4).
steps: The CB passes to the LB and starts his run.
The CB goes in as a second line player. The front defender follows him: the centre empties.
The LB attacks the free space: shot, or pass to the line player.

a5.titre: Back - centre back cross behind the front defender
a5.objectif: Use the cross to draw the front defender and exploit the space behind him.
orga: 6 against 6 on half a court, 5-1 defence.
Start with the ball at the CB.
consignes: The back heads for the centre with the ball to commit the front defender.
The CB crosses behind him at the right moment, not too early.
The line player gets free on the side opposite the cross.
variantes: If #2 steps out on the CB, play wide to the left wing.
Same combination on the right.
steps: The CB passes to the LB.
The LB heads for the centre and draws the front defender. The CB crosses behind him.
Pass to the CB behind the front defender. #2 has to step out.
The CB shoots if #2 is late stepping out, otherwise he passes to the wing.

a6.titre: Switch play, draw #2, free the wing
a6.objectif: Take advantage of the defence being late after a fast switch of play.
orga: 6 against 6 on half a court, 5-1 defence.
Start with the ball at the RB.
consignes: Switch play with a skip pass, without stopping the ball in the centre.
The back attacks the 1-2 gap to draw #2.
The wing stays wide until the last moment.
variantes: If #1 closes on the wing, the back shoots or looks for the line player.
steps: The RB switches play with a skip pass to the LB. The defence shifts late.
The LB attacks the 1-2 gap and draws #2.
Pass out to the left wing.
Shot from the wing.

a7.titre: Wing run-in: playing with two line players
a7.objectif: Turn the 5-1 into a defence against two line players to open a gap.
orga: 6 against 6 on half a court, 5-1 defence.
Start with the ball at the LB, line player on the right.
consignes: The far wing runs in without the ball along the 6 m line, away from the ball.
He blocks #4: the 4-5 gap opens.
The RB attacks the gap or passes to the second line player.
variantes: Same thing with the left wing running in.
steps: The LB passes to the CB. The right wing starts running inside.
The CB passes to the RB. The wing becomes a second line player and blocks #4.
The RB attacks the open 4-5 gap and shoots.

a8.objectif: Put the session's solutions back into the game.
orga: 6 against 6 on half or full court, the defence plays a 5-1.
Swap roles every 5 attacks.
consignes: A goal after an overload or a CB penetration counts double.
Don't rush the ball circulation.
If nothing opens up, bring the ball back to the wing to reset everyone.
variantes: The defence switches between 5-1 and 6-0 without warning: the attack must recognise the system.

d1.titre: Shifting of the line of five
d1.objectif: Move together with the ball: the defender facing the ball steps out, the others cover.
orga: Five defenders on 6 m plus the front defender.
Five passers (wings and backs) passing the ball without shooting.
consignes: Defender facing the ball: steps out, arms up.
His neighbours close in behind him.
Side steps, never crossing the feet.
variantes: The passers may shoot if a gap stays open.
steps: Ball at the LB: #2 steps out, the others shift towards the ball.
Pass to the CB: the front defender presses, the line recentres.
Pass to the RB: #4 steps out, the front defender cuts the passing lane to the CB.

d2.objectif: Cut the CB out of the game and force turnovers.
orga: One front defender against three backs (LB, CB, RB), a goalkeeper.
The backs may not dribble.
consignes: Always between the ball and the CB.
Deter: arm in the passing lane, without diving in.
On a slow pass, intercept and go on the fast break.
variantes: Add a line player the front defender must also watch.
steps: Ball at the LB: the front defender gets between the ball and the CB.
The CB is cut off: the LB switches play with a skip pass. The front defender shifts.
Pass too slow towards the CB: the front defender intercepts.
Direct fast break.

d3.titre: Step out, cover, recover: the 1-2 pair
d3.objectif: Coordinate the two defenders on the same side.
orga: 2 against 2: LB and LW against #1 and #2, a goalkeeper.
consignes: #2 steps out on the back, #1 covers the gap.
On the pass to the wing, #2 gets back quickly and #1 closes the angle.
Talk: “I'm out”, “I've got cover”.
variantes: Add a line player between #1 and #2.
steps: The LB attacks: #2 steps out, #1 covers the gap.
Pass to the wing: #1 closes the angle, #2 gets back.
The wing shoots from a closed angle: advantage to the goalkeeper.

d4.titre: The line player behind the front defender
d4.objectif: Never leave the line player free in the centre.
orga: 4 against 4 in the centre: LB, CB, RB and line player against the front defender, #2, #3 and #4.
consignes: #3 calls “line player!” and takes him in front of him.
The front defender bothers the CB to slow the pass.
On the pass to the back, #3 resets and #2 steps out.
variantes: The line player changes side every attack.
steps: The line player moves into the space behind the front defender.
#3 steps up and takes him in front. The front defender bothers the CB.
Pass to the LB: #2 steps out, #3 resets.

orga: 6 against 6, the defence plays a 5-1.
Series of 6 attacks, then swap roles.
consignes: 1 point for the defence for every ball won.
2 points for an interception by the front defender.
variantes: The attack plays with two line players to force the defence to adapt.

m1.objectif: Get free to help a harassed ball carrier.
orga: Groups of 3: two attackers, one defender.
A limited space in the centre.
consignes: The defender always harasses the ball carrier.
The non-carrier calls for the ball behind the defender.
Pass with the elbow high, no dribbling.
variantes: Bounce pass compulsory.
Jump pass compulsory.
steps: The defender harasses A. B gets free and calls.
The defender switches to B. A runs behind him to call for the ball again.
And again.

m2.titre: Two against two in the central area
m2.objectif: Create free space with a change of direction.
orga: 2 against 2 in the centre, a goalkeeper.
No dribbling to move forward.
consignes: Take your defender to the outside, then cut behind him.
The type of pass is set: bounce pass, then jump pass.
variantes: Narrow the space to make getting free harder.
steps: B takes his defender to the outside.
Change of direction: B cuts behind the defender and receives.
Shot.

m3.titre: Pull wide and go past without the ball
m3.objectif: Coordinate ball carrier and non-carrier to receive in the gap.
orga: 2 against 2 facing two advanced defenders, a goalkeeper.
consignes: A moves wide with the ball to pull his defender out.
At the same time, B goes past his to receive in the gap.
Stay balanced on the feint.
variantes: First pass must be a bounce pass.
B goes past without the ball to receive behind.
steps: A moves wide with the ball and takes his defender with him.
B feints outside, then cuts into the gap and receives.
Shot in the gap.

m4.titre: Three against three: the wing runs in as line player
m4.objectif: Link a back getting free and the wing running in.
orga: 3 against 3: CB, RB and a left wing against three defenders.
A goalkeeper.
consignes: The wing runs in as the back attacks.
Very accurate passes to the line player.
variantes: Move to 5 against 5 with a real line player.
steps: The wing runs in as line player along the 6 m line.
The CB passes to the RB, who attacks: #4 steps out.
The RB finds the freed line player.
Shot by the line player.

i1.objectif: Take in information and look for free space rather than running at the defender.
orga: One attacker with a ball, a defender on the side, a goalkeeper.
The defender comes on when the attacker sets off.
consignes: “You have to go and score. Watch out for the defender.”
Move away from the defender and take the free space.
variantes: Two defenders; only one comes on, at the coach's signal.
steps: The defender comes on: the attacker moves away and takes the free space.
He arrives alone and shoots.

i2.objectif: If the gap closes, go past the off-balance defender.
orga: Two cones make a gate. A defender comes from the side.
One attacker, a goalkeeper.
consignes: First go towards the gap.
The defender closes on the run: he is off balance.
Go round him on the side opposite his run.
variantes: Vary when the defender starts (earlier, later).
steps: The attacker goes straight for the gap. The defender runs to close it.
The defender is off balance: go round him on the opposite side.
Shot.

i3.objectif: Link attacking the gap, the closing defender and the pass, twice in a row.
orga: Two attackers against two defenders placed one behind the other.
The first defender steps in before 13 m, the second before 9 m.
consignes: “I mustn't get touched. If I'm about to be, I pass.”
The teammate gives support, slightly ahead.
Bounce pass recommended for beginners.
variantes: Change the starting positions of attackers and defenders.
steps: A takes the gap. #1 closes: pass to B, in support.
B moves forward. #2 closes: pass to A, who has got free.
A shoots.

c1.titre: First wave: the goalkeeper launches the wing
c1.objectif: Score within 3 to 4 seconds of the save, before the opponents get back.
orga: A goalkeeper in each goal, two lines of wings.
A shooter at 9 m starts it: the goalkeeper saves or collects the ball.
consignes: The wing goes as soon as the shot is saved, not later.
Curved run: first move wide, then sprint in your lane.
The goalkeeper looks, controls, then throws ahead of the wing, never to a standing player.
variantes: A defender chases from the centre line.
The goalkeeper chooses the freer of the two wings.
steps: Goalkeeper save: the left wing goes straight away, on a curved run.
Long pass from the goalkeeper, ahead of the wing.
The wing finishes alone against the goalkeeper.

c2.titre: Two against one moving the ball up
c2.objectif: Draw the recovering defender, then pass to the free teammate.
orga: Two attackers start from their area, a defender starts from the middle.
A goalkeeper in each goal.
consignes: The ball carrier attacks the defender to force him to choose.
The non-carrier stays wide and ahead.
Pass at the right moment: when the defender commits to the ball carrier.
variantes: Three against two.
Dribbling limited to three bounces.
steps: Both wings set off. The goalkeeper feeds the right wing.
The right wing attacks the defender to draw him. The left wing stays wide.
The defender commits: pass to the left wing, who is free.
Shot.

c3.titre: Three against two: the second wave
c3.objectif: When the first wave is blocked, the CB arrives at speed and creates the overload.
orga: Both wings are already up, the CB restarts from his own half.
Two defenders get back in the centre.
consignes: The wings stay wide, close to the sideline, to stretch the defence.
The CB attacks the space between the two defenders, ball in hand.
If a defender steps out on him: pass to the wing on that side.
variantes: Add a third defender who gets back late (3 against 2 + 1).
steps: The CB brings the ball up fast. The wings keep the width.
The CB attacks between the two defenders, who close in on him.
Pass to the left wing, left free.
Shot.

c4.objectif: Move the ball up fast without being touched, choosing between passing and moving forward.
orga: Two teams of 4 against 4 to 6 against 6, on the whole court.
Handball rules. The defence may touch the ball carrier.
consignes: The fewer touches, the more the goal is worth: 5 points with no touch, 3 points with one touch, 1 point with two.
A threatened ball carrier passes quickly to a teammate in support, ahead of him.
variantes: Rounds to 10, 15 or 20 points for young players, to 5 goals for seniors.
Reverse it: the attack must touch defenders before scoring.

c5.objectif: Outrun a team coming back to defend.
orga: Two teams of 4 against 4 to 6 against 6.
The recovering team sits in the centre circle, except for its shooter.
A cone at 9 m on each side.
consignes: On the shot, the fast-break players go round the cone at 9 m, then sprint towards the other goal.
The seated players get up and get back.
Remember the three moments: opponent's shot, goalkeeper collects, restart.
variantes: The recovering players wait for the goalkeeper's restart before moving: you then work on keeping the ball.

c6.objectif: Choose between going fast and keeping the ball.
orga: 4 against 4 or 5 against 5 with two goalkeepers.
The court is divided into four zones.
consignes: The goalkeeper restarts when all four zones are occupied.
Goal scored after crossing one or two zones: it counts for speed.
Goal scored after three or four zones: it counts for possession.
An interception gives the fast break to the other team.
variantes: Bonus if the goal is scored within 5 seconds of the restart.

p1.titre: The line player's block to free the shot
p1.objectif: Use the line player's block to gain a step on the defender.
orga: A line player, a defender at 9 m, backs in a line, a passer.
Same drill on both sides.
consignes: The back first goes inside to draw the defender.
The line player blocks with contact, arms by his sides, as the pass is made.
The back goes away from the block and shoots.
variantes: Block on the inside to set up an outside shot, then the reverse.
steps: The passer feeds the LB, who goes inside and draws the defender.
The line player blocks the defender on the inside. The LB goes back outside.
Shot by the back, freed by the block.

p2.titre: The screen: shooting over the line player
p2.objectif: Hide the shot behind the line player's screen.
orga: A line player, a defender at 6-7 m, backs as shooters, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The line player stands between the defender and the shooter, without moving at the moment of the shot.
The shooter takes off just behind the screen and takes a jump shot.
variantes: The defender may go round the screen: the shooter must shoot fast.
steps: The line player gets between the defender and the shooter.
Jump shot over the screen.

p3.objectif: After the block, the line player turns towards the goal and becomes a passing option.
orga: 2 against 2: a back and a line player against two 6 m defenders.
A passer, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The line player blocks #2 on the inside.
The back attacks the inside space.
If #3 steps out on the back, the line player rolls behind him and calls for the ball.
variantes: #3 has a choice: step out or stay. The back reads and decides.
steps: The line player blocks #2 on the inside.
The LB attacks inside. #3 steps out on him.
The line player rolls behind #3 and receives.
Shot by the line player.

p4.titre: Two line players: one blocks, the other takes the space
p4.objectif: Create space with one line player and use it with the other.
orga: LB, RB and two line players against three 6 m defenders.
A goalkeeper.
consignes: The first line player blocks the central defender.
The back attacks to draw help from the neighbouring defender.
The second line player gets free in the space left open.
variantes: Add a front defender who bothers the passes.
steps: The first line player blocks #3. The LB attacks towards the centre.
#4 comes to help in the centre: the second line player slips into the free space.
Shot by the second line player.

p5.titre: Match: line player goals count double
p5.objectif: Look for the line player in a match, at the right moment.
orga: 6 against 6 on half or full court.
consignes: A goal scored by the line player, or after a line player's block, counts double.
Don't force the pass to the line player if he is marked: the ball is lost.
variantes: Play with two line players for 5 minutes.

g1.objectif: The goalkeeper moves in an arc to always narrow the shooting angle.
orga: Five passers around the 9 m line, a goalkeeper.
The passers move the ball without shooting, then shoot on a signal.
consignes: Stay on the line from the ball to the middle of the goal.
The wider the ball, the closer you stay to the near post.
Side steps, active feet, hands in front.
variantes: The coach shouts “shoot”: the ball carrier shoots immediately.
steps: Pass to the LB: the goalkeeper leaves the near post and moves out a little.
Ball at the CB: the goalkeeper is central, one step off his line.
Ball at the RB: he slides to the right.
Ball at the right wing: he closes the near post.

g2.objectif: Chain low, mid-height and high saves.
orga: A goalkeeper, two or three shooters at 7 m, one ball each.
consignes: The shooter calls the target area: the goalkeeper works on the right movement.
Return to the basic position between shots.
Increase the speed once the movement is clean.
variantes: The shooter no longer calls it: the goalkeeper reads the shooter's arm.

g3.objectif: Close the near post and narrow the angle on wing shots.
orga: A line of wings, a passer in the back court, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The goalkeeper closes the near post as soon as the wing receives.
He moves out along the wing's path when he jumps.
He doesn't dive before the shot.
variantes: The wings may use a spin shot or a lob.
steps: Pass to the wing on the run. The goalkeeper closes the near post.
The wing jumps into the area. The goalkeeper moves out on the angle.
Shot: the goalkeeper stays big as long as possible.

g4.objectif: Share the goal with the defender who blocks.
orga: A back shooter, a blocking defender, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The blocker closes the shooter's arm side.
The goalkeeper takes the other side, the far corner.
Talk before each series: who takes what.
variantes: The shooter may feint: the blocker must stay on his feet.
steps: The LB attacks. #2 blocks on the arm side, the goalkeeper shifts to the far corner.
Shot: the goalkeeper waits for the ball on his side.

g5.titre: Match with objectives for the goalkeepers
g5.objectif: Help goalkeepers improve during team play.
orga: Match or half-court situation.
Each goalkeeper gets his own objective, for example: restart within 3 seconds, or call out the defence's positioning.
consignes: The coach follows one goalkeeper for 5 minutes, then the other.
The court players know the drill and play on their own.
variantes: Count each goalkeeper's successful restarts.

dd1.objectif: Defend with the legs and trunk, not with the arms.
orga: Two players, one cone. The attacker dribbles, the defender holds a ball with both hands.
consignes: The attacker has to touch the cone.
The defender stays between the attacker and the cone, with side steps.
No arms allowed: they are busy holding the ball.
variantes: Two cones: the attacker chooses which to touch.
The attacker has to get between two cones.
steps: The attacker goes left. The defender slides and stays in his way.
Change of direction: the defender slides again, without crossing his feet.

dd2.titre: Watch the ball carrier, sense the other attacker
dd2.objectif: Read the game to prevent the pass.
orga: Three players, one ball: a ball carrier, an attacker trying to get free, a defender.
Limited space.
consignes: The defender watches the ball carrier and keeps the other attacker in sight.
He positions himself to cut the passing lane, not behind his attacker.
variantes: Both attackers move freely, bounce pass compulsory.
steps: A2 gets free towards the outside. The defender follows, watching the ball carrier.
A2 comes back inside: the defender, well placed, cuts out the pass.

dd3.titre: Stopping the shooter within the rules
dd3.objectif: Make the right contact: on the throwing arm and the hip, without pushing.
orga: Two attackers passing to each other with jump passes, a defender between them and the goal.
consignes: The defender makes contact with the shooter, from the front.
One hand on the throwing arm, one on the hip.
Never from behind, never on a player in the air.
variantes: The attackers may play one-on-one.

dd4.titre: Get up and defend your area
dd4.objectif: React fast and win the duel in your area.
orga: Lines of attacking backs, a passer.
Two defenders lying on their backs between 6 and 7 m.
consignes: On the signal, the passer gives to an attacker: the defender for that area gets up and stops the shot.
Each defends his own area. 2 against 2 is allowed.
variantes: The defenders start sitting, then lying on their front.

dd5.objectif: Win your duels at every level of the court.
orga: 4 against 4: a 1 against 1 in the 6 m area, a 1 against 1 between 6 and 9 m, a 2 against 2 further out.
Two neutral passers.
consignes: Each defender stays in his lane.
A ball won earns the defence a point.
variantes: The lanes are removed after 5 minutes: the defence must help each other.

jj1.objectif: Receive on the move and make yourself available.
orga: Two teams, each in its own half.
Handball rules, no dribbling.
consignes: Make ten passes in a row in your half.
Don't give the ball back to the player who just passed it.
Receive while running, not standing still.
variantes: One player from each team goes to the other half to defend, then two, then three.
At the end, the two halves join up and play evenly.

jj2.objectif: Move the ball towards a target and pass accurately.
orga: Two teams. Each team has a captain standing in a hoop, at the back of the opponents' half.
consignes: One point when the captain catches the ball without leaving the hoop.
No contact, no dribbling at first.
variantes: Two captains per team.
The captain must score in a small goal after receiving.

jj3.objectif: React fast, then play the duel facing the goal.
orga: Two teams lined up on each side, each player has a number.
A ball in the centre, two small goals.
consignes: The coach calls a number: both players race for the ball.
The one who gets it attacks, the other defends: 1 against 1 all the way to the goal.
variantes: Call two numbers: 2 against 2.

jj4.objectif: Look up and pass before being touched.
orga: Two teams on half a court.
consignes: The defending team must touch the ball carrier.
Ball carrier touched: the ball goes to the other team.
The attack scores by placing the ball in the goal area.
variantes: Not allowed to hold the ball for more than 3 seconds.

jj5.objectif: Everyone touches the ball and takes part.
orga: 5 against 5 with a goalkeeper, small goals, goal area at 5 m.
consignes: No dribbling: move forward by passing.
A goal counts double if the whole team touched the ball before.
variantes: Allow just one dribble per possession.

w-triangle.objectif: Warm up the arm and the feet by linking pass and movement.
orga: Groups of 3 to 4 players in a triangle, 5 to 6 m apart, one ball.
After the pass, follow your ball to the next position.
consignes: Receive with cupped hands, arms stretched towards the passer.
Chest pass, then one-handed pass with the arm cocked high.
Speed up every minute.
variantes: Two balls per triangle.
Change direction on the whistle.
Bounce pass compulsory for the youngest.
steps: A passes to B and follows his ball.
B passes to C and follows his ball.
C passes to A, already in place, and follows in turn.

w-appuis.objectif: Wake up the feet and upper body as in defence.
orga: In pairs, face to face, over a 4 m width between two cones.
A leader moves with side steps, the other copies.
consignes: Stay low, feet shoulder-width apart.
Never cross your feet.
Arms up each time the leader stops.
variantes: The leader holds a ball and fakes a pass: the defender raises his arm.
Finish with a 10 m sprint on the signal.

w-passe10.titre: Ten passes on half a court
w-passe10.objectif: Get going by playing, with getting free and communication.
orga: Two teams on half a court, one ball.
Ten passes in a row without losing it: one point.
consignes: Not allowed to give the ball back to the player who just passed.
Call for the ball out loud.
No contact on the ball carrier.
variantes: One-handed passes only.
The point counts double if the tenth pass reaches a line player's area.

w-colonnes.objectif: Warm up the goalkeeper and shooting on the run, with varied targets.
orga: One line at LB, one at RB, one ball per player.
Each player passes to the player opposite, gets it back and shoots.
consignes: Shot on the run, without stopping.
The goalkeeper starts with placed shots, then the shooters speed up.
Change lines after your shot.
variantes: Pass to the line player, then shot by the line player.
Jump shot over a raised arm (tall cone or teammate).
steps: The player on the left passes diagonally and starts towards the goal.
The player on the right gives the ball back into his run.
Shot on the run.

r-cibles.objectif: Finish calmly while working on shooting accuracy.
orga: Targets (hoops, bibs) hung in the four corners of the goal, no goalkeeper.
Each player shoots from 7 m.
consignes: Standing shot, no run-up.
Call your target before shooting.
variantes: Shot from the wing position.
Team contest: the first to hit all four targets wins.

r-binome.objectif: Bring the heart rate down and talk about the session.
orga: In pairs, walking, then short two-handed passes over 10 m.
consignes: Each pair finds one thing that went well and one point to work on.
Quick sharing in front of the group.
variantes: Stretching led by a different player each session.

a1b.titre: Long-range shot over the line of five
a1b.objectif: Punish a 5-1 that stays on its 6 m line with the 9 m shot.
orga: Two lines of backs (LB, RB), a CB as passer, a goalkeeper.
Two defenders on the 6 m line, arms up, who don't step out.
consignes: Three steps of run-up maximum, then jump shot.
Shoot over or beside the arms, never into them.
Look at the goal before receiving.
variantes: The defenders may take one step forward.
Hip-height standing shot, under the arms.
steps: The CB feeds the LB, who takes his run-up.
The LB jumps up over #2.
Shot beside the arms.

a2b.titre: Pass to the line player behind the front defender
a2b.objectif: Find the line player in the space the front defender leaves behind him.
orga: A CB, two backs, a line player, a front defender, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The line player sets up behind the front defender, between #3 and #4.
Bounce pass or lob if the front defender has his arm up.
The line player receives, turns and shoots.
variantes: Add #3 of the defence: the line player must get free first.
steps: The LB passes to the CB. The front defender steps up on the CB.
The line player slips in behind the front defender.
Bounce pass to the line player.
The line player turns and shoots.

a3b.objectif: Create an overload on the side by playing two against #1 and #2.
orga: LB and LW against #1 and #2, a CB as passer, a goalkeeper.
Same work on the right afterwards.
consignes: The LB attacks the gap between #1 and #2.
If #1 steps out, pass to the wing who stays on his line.
If #1 stays, the LB shoots or keeps going.
variantes: The wing runs in as a second line player if #1 is very high.
Add the line player on the ball side.
steps: The LB receives on the run and attacks between #1 and #2.
#1 steps out on him.
Pass to the wing, who stayed wide.
The wing shoots, opening up the angle.

a5b.objectif: Make the defence drop and step up with successive attacks to open a hole.
orga: Three backs and a line player against three 6 m defenders and the front defender.
A goalkeeper.
consignes: Each back attacks towards the goal, passes, then drops back to go again.
Look for the defender who steps out too late.
No shot before the third pass.
variantes: Allow the shot from the first pass.
Add the wings for 6 against 6.

a6b.titre: Back and line player against #3 and the front defender
a6b.objectif: Read the #3 - front defender pair and choose between shot, pass to the line player or going past.
orga: Two against two in the centre, a passer, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The line player blocks the front defender or #3, whichever is more threatening.
The back goes on the side of the block.
If both defenders close in, the line player rolls towards the goal.
variantes: The passer may become a third attacker.

a9.objectif: Dare the 9 m shot and trouble the 5-1 with width.
orga: Half-court match, the defence plays a 5-1.
Swap roles every 6 attacks.
consignes: A goal scored from beyond 9 m counts double.
A goal from the wing also counts double, to keep the width.
variantes: Very high front defender: work on the pass behind him.

d1b.titre: Step out on the ball carrier and get back
d1b.objectif: Make stepping out on the shooter and getting back into the line automatic.
orga: Three defenders on the 6 m line facing three backs passing the ball.
The backs don't shoot at first.
consignes: The defender facing the ball carrier steps out, arm up, and comes back as soon as the ball leaves.
His neighbours close in when he steps out.
Get back moving backwards, without turning your back.
variantes: The backs may shoot if they are free.
Add a line player the line must control.
steps: The LB has the ball: #2 steps out on him, his neighbours close in.
Pass to the CB: #2 gets back, #3 steps out.
Pass to the RB: #3 gets back, #4 steps out.

d2b.titre: The front defender cuts the passes
d2b.objectif: Teach the front defender to read passing lanes and intercept.
orga: Three backs move the ball in front of a front defender.
A line player and two 6 m defenders complete it.
consignes: The front defender stands between the ball carrier and his nearest teammate.
Successful interception: direct fast break towards the other goal.
Don't go behind a back: stay between him and the centre.
variantes: Ban the skip pass to help the front defender at first.

d3b.titre: Defending the wing: #1 closes the angle
d3b.objectif: Stop the wing receiving at a good angle and force him to shoot far from the goal.
orga: A wing, a back as passer and a #1 on each side, a goalkeeper.
consignes: #1 stands in front of the passing lane to the wing.
If he still receives, #1 pushes him towards the goal line.
The goalkeeper and #1 talk: one closes the near post, the other the rest.
variantes: The wing may run in as a second line player: #1 must follow him or hand him over.
steps: #1 positions himself on the passing lane to the wing.
The wing still receives, moving backwards.
#1 pushes him towards the goal line: angle closed, difficult shot.

d4b.titre: Defending a cross: switch or follow
d4b.objectif: Don't let a cross open a hole in the line.
orga: Two backs crossing against two 6 m defenders and the front defender.
A goalkeeper.
consignes: Call the cross out loud.
The defender on the ball side stays on the ball carrier, the other takes the incoming player.
Never drop back two on the same player.
variantes: Add a line player who blocks at the moment of the cross.

d6.objectif: Hold a 5-0 defence short-handed, as after a suspension.
orga: Six attackers against five defenders on half a court.
Seven attacks, then swap.
consignes: Stay compact, without stepping out too high.
Leave the far-side wing and protect the centre.
A defence that holds for 30 seconds scores a point.
variantes: Switch to a 4-1: the front defender bothers the circulation.

m1b.titre: Four against two in a square
m1b.objectif: Show yourself in the right place to give the ball carrier two options.
orga: 8 m by 8 m square, four attackers on the sides, two defenders in the middle.
consignes: The ball carrier's two neighbours show themselves, the opposite one hides behind the defenders.
The defender who intercepts takes the passer's place.
variantes: One touch maximum.
Make the square smaller.

m2b.titre: Give and go towards the goal
m2b.objectif: After the pass, go straight away to receive behind the defender.
orga: Two attackers against one defender, a goalkeeper.
Start at 12 m.
consignes: I pass, then I cut behind my defender.
The receiver gives it straight back, ahead of the run.
Change pace at the moment of the pass.
variantes: An extra defender in a covering position.
steps: A passes to B. The defender watches the ball.
A cuts behind the defender.
B gives the ball back ahead of the run.
A shoots.

m3b.objectif: Combine a short run and a deep run to lose the defender.
orga: Three against three on half a court, a goalkeeper.
consignes: Fake coming towards the ball, then go behind.
The ball carrier looks at the run before passing.
No more than three seconds with the ball.
variantes: Goal only counts after a successful run behind.

m5.objectif: Force everyone to get free to move the ball forward.
orga: 5 against 5 or 6 against 6 match on the whole court.
consignes: No dribbling allowed.
Goal counts double after a give and go.
variantes: One dribble allowed per player per possession.

i1b.objectif: Choose the free gate and go through it with the ball.
orga: Three gates made of cones on the 9 m line.
Two defenders who can each close one gate.
consignes: Look before you run.
Go through the free gate, then shoot.
The defenders close with their body, without taking the ball.
variantes: Two attackers: the one without the ball calls in the free gate.

i2b.titre: Three against two: draw and pass
i2b.objectif: Draw two defenders to free a teammate.
orga: Three attackers against two defenders on 9 m, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The ball carrier attacks between the two defenders.
When both come to him, he passes outside.
The others stay wide.
variantes: Add a third defender who starts late.
steps: The ball carrier attacks the gap between the two defenders.
Both defenders close in on him.
Pass to the right to the player left free.
Shot.

i2c.objectif: Attack the gap while respecting the lanes.
orga: Court split into two lanes. One attacker and one defender per lane.
consignes: The defender doesn't leave his lane.
The attacker attacks the line between the lanes to bring both defenders in.
variantes: The defenders may change lanes.

i4.objectif: Find again in a match the reflex of going between two defenders.
orga: 4 against 4 or 5 against 5 match with a goalkeeper.
Defence in a line in front of the goal area.
consignes: A goal scored after going between two defenders counts double.
The coach stops play to praise good choices.
variantes: Defence further forward to leave more space.

c1b.objectif: Make the long pass ahead of a teammate running at speed.
orga: In pairs, along the whole length of the court.
A standing passer, a runner who goes on the signal.
consignes: Pass ahead of the runner, never behind him.
The runner watches the ball over his shoulder.
Finish with a shot.
variantes: The goalkeeper makes the pass.
Pass at 15 m, then 20 m, then 25 m.

c3b.objectif: Restart very quickly at centre court and attack a defence not yet set.
orga: Four attackers against two defenders getting back late.
After each goal, immediate throw-off at centre court.
consignes: The goalkeeper restarts straight away to the CB, who runs to the centre.
The wings go as soon as the goal is conceded.
Attack before the defence is four strong.
variantes: An extra defender who starts at the throw-off.
steps: Quick throw-off: the CB restarts, the wings set off.
The CB attacks the centre, the two defenders close in.
Pass to the right wing, who is free.
Shot.

c5b.objectif: Slow down a fast break when you are late.
orga: Three attackers go on the fast break, two defenders get back.
A goalkeeper.
consignes: The first defender back protects the centre and the area.
He makes the ball carrier back off without diving in.
The goalkeeper talks to direct the recovery.
variantes: A third defender comes back three seconds late.

c7.objectif: Link fast attack and getting back on defence, as in a match.
orga: 6 against 6 on the whole court.
consignes: Goal scored within 10 seconds of winning the ball: 2 points.
Team with a player who hasn't crossed the centre line when getting back: the opponents' goal counts double.
variantes: Quick throw-off compulsory after each goal.

p1b.objectif: Receive well with your back to goal, turn and shoot in balance.
orga: A line player on the 6 m line, two passers in the back positions, a goalkeeper.
A passive defender in contact with the line player.
consignes: Receive with two hands, arms stretched towards the passer.
Pivot on the foot on the defender's side, then shoot falling.
Keep the shoulders facing the goal when shooting.
variantes: Active defender.
Bounce pass, then lob, then flat pass.

p2b.titre: The line player gets free along the 6 m line
p2b.objectif: Move sideways to offer a passing lane.
orga: A line player and two defenders on the 6 m line, three back passers.
consignes: The line player always sets up on the ball side, between two defenders.
He moves with every pass from the backs.
Hand out to call for the ball.
variantes: The defenders may intercept.
steps: The CB passes to the LB. The line player slides left, to the ball side.
#3 follows the line player and a space opens: pass to the line player.
The line player turns and shoots.

p4b.titre: The wing runs in as second line player
p4b.objectif: Add a line player to overload one side of the defence.
orga: Wing, two backs and a line player against three defenders and a #1.
A goalkeeper.
consignes: The wing runs in behind #1 as the back attacks.
The two line players block different defenders.
The back reads the space created.
variantes: Same thing on the right.

p6.titre: 4 against 4 with a line player on each side
p6.objectif: Look for the line player in a small-sided match.
orga: Three backs and a line player against four defenders, on half a court.
consignes: Line player goal: 2 points.
Goal after a line player's block: 2 points.
variantes: Change line player every attack.

g1b.objectif: Move fast and stay well placed between the ball and the goal.
orga: Five cones in an arc at 9 m, a ball on each.
A coach points to a cone: the goalkeeper gets into position.
consignes: Side steps, feet never crossed.
Stay on the ball - middle of the goal line.
Hands at shoulder height, ready to go.
variantes: The coach shoots as soon as the goalkeeper is in place.

g2b.titre: Wing shots: close the near post
g2b.objectif: Narrow the angle against the wing without opening the far post.
orga: A line of wings on each side, a goalkeeper.
consignes: Stick to the near post with your body.
Arm and leg on the post side block the short angle.
Wait for the shot, don't dive too early.
variantes: The wings may lob.

g3b.titre: Against the line player: stay big
g3b.objectif: Win the duel against a close-range shot.
orga: A line player receives from a back on the 6 m line, a goalkeeper.
consignes: Step forward to close the angle.
Stay upright and big, arms and legs spread.
Don't go down before the shot.
variantes: Passive defender on the line player.

g4b.objectif: Link the save to the immediate restart.
orga: A shooter at 9 m, two wings ready to go, a goalkeeper.
consignes: After the save, control the ball in less than a second.
Look at the wings before throwing.
Pass ahead of the runner.
variantes: A defender chases.

g6.objectif: Read the shooter and take the initiative on 7 m throws.
orga: All the shooters in a line, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The goalkeeper may move out up to 4 m.
Show one side to draw the shot to the other.
Count the saves: a record to beat.
variantes: The shooter has only 3 seconds after the whistle.

dd1b.objectif: Follow the attacker while staying in front of him.
orga: In pairs, in a 4 m lane.
The attacker dribbles and tries to cross the end line.
consignes: Stay between the attacker and the line.
Move with side steps.
Don't go for the ball, go for the position.
variantes: The attacker has no ball and feints with his body.

dd2b.objectif: Close one side of the goal with your arms to help the goalkeeper.
orga: A shooter at 9 m, a blocking defender on the 6 m line, a goalkeeper.
consignes: Arms stretched, hands open, above the head.
The blocker closes the shooter's arm side, the goalkeeper takes the other.
Jump at the moment of the shot, not before.
variantes: The shooter may fake the shot.

dd3b.titre: One against one in a lane
dd3b.objectif: Stop the attacker getting to goal in a narrow space.
orga: 5 m wide lane from the centre line to the goal area.
One attacker, one defender, a goalkeeper.
consignes: Move towards the attacker to bother him early.
Steer him to the outside of the lane.
If the defender wins the ball: he attacks in turn.
variantes: Widen the lane to make defending harder.
steps: The attacker sets off with the ball. The defender moves towards him.
The defender steers him to the outside.
Angle closed: the attacker shoots from a poor position or loses the ball.

dd4b.titre: Two against two: help and recover
dd4b.objectif: Help your teammate in a duel without abandoning your player.
orga: Two attackers against two defenders, a goalkeeper.
consignes: The defender on the ball side steps out on the ball carrier.
The other moves closer to help, then gets back to his player on the pass.
Talk: “I'm out”, “I've got cover”.
variantes: Three against three.

dd6.objectif: Win every duel over the whole half court.
orga: 5 against 5 on half a court, each defender has his attacker.
consignes: A ball won: 1 point for the defence.
No foul in 30 seconds: 1 more point.
variantes: Full-court man-to-man defence.

jj1b.objectif: Handle the ball while running and learn to pass quickly.
orga: Two teams, a pile of balls in the centre, a box per team.
consignes: Bring one ball at a time back to your box, passing with a teammate.
No travelling with the ball: pass it.
variantes: Allowed to take a ball from the other team's box.

jj2b.objectif: Dribble with your head up to avoid the hawks.
orga: All players with a ball on a line, one hawk in the middle.
consignes: Cross while dribbling without being touched.
Player touched: becomes a hawk, without a ball.
variantes: The hawks must take the ball instead of touching.

jj3b.objectif: Aim and shoot hard at a protected target.
orga: Skittles or cones in the goal area, two teams.
A goalkeeper protects the skittles.
consignes: Shoot from outside the goal area.
Each skittle knocked down is worth a point.
variantes: Two goalkeepers.
A pass is compulsory before the shot.

jj4b.objectif: Look up to find the least defended goal.
orga: Four small goals in the corners, two teams.
Each team attacks two goals and defends two.
consignes: Switch sides if one goal is too well defended.
No goalkeeper: defend with your body.
variantes: A goalkeeper who moves from one goal to the other.

jj6.objectif: Encourage trying things: jump shots, feints, risky passes.
orga: 4 against 4 with goalkeepers, small goals, goal area at 5 m.
consignes: A jump-shot goal counts double.
A bold attempt is applauded even if it fails.
variantes: Every player must score at least once before anyone scores again.

climat.titre: A climate that helps players improve
climat.idee: Praising progress, effort and mutual help brings a team together. Rivalry, punishing mistakes and winning at all costs damage it.
texte: A study of women's top-division clubs shows that the coach's attitude weighs on group cohesion. When the coach emphasises learning and cooperation, the group works better, on and off the court.
Putting players in constant competition with each other to make them more effective does not seem to work: above all, it weakens cohesion.
pratique: Point out a specific improvement every session, however small.
Praise team actions (an assist, defensive help), not just goals.
Avoid comparing players with each other in front of the group.
A mistake made while taking a sensible risk is not a fault: say so.
climat.src: Based on a study of cohesion and motivational climate in the French women's top division, Approches du Handball no. 76

abandon.titre: Why young players quit, and how to keep them
abandon.idee: Young players come for different reasons. When they quit, it is often because they are bored or no longer improving.
texte: Some come for their friends, others to win, others to improve, others still for the approval of the coach or their parents. Knowing these motivations well lets you adapt what you say to each one.
The feeling of no longer learning anything comes up often among those who quit. Well-built training, adapted to each player's level, is the best way to keep them.
pratique: At the start of the season, ask each player what they enjoy and what they find hard in handball.
Watch attitudes: the player who doesn't dare, the one who excels in front of their parents.
Vary the drills and always keep some playing time.
Take the drama out of matches: the result is not the only goal.
abandon.src: Based on Philippe Sarrazin, Approches du Handball no. 39

objectifs.idee: “Do your best” motivates nobody. “3 assists this weekend” gives a clear direction.
texte: Mastery goals are personal, adapted to the player's position and level, measurable and set for the next match or the next week.
They only work if the coach gives feedback: goal reached or not, and why. Involving the player in choosing the goal makes them responsible.
pratique: Before a match, give each player a numerical goal linked to their position.
Review it in two minutes at the next session.
Let the player suggest their own goal, as a small contract.
objectifs.src: Based on Philippe Sarrazin, Approches du Handball no. 39

manager.idee: Your team will never play the handball you dream of, but the handball its qualities allow. Speak to it in words it understands.
texte: A manager is first and foremost a communicator. Words that mean something to you don't necessarily mean anything to the players. You have to check the message has been understood.
Beware of wanting your team to play the way you were taught, or of copying a trend. Start from the real characteristics of your group.
pratique: After an instruction, ask a player to put it in his own words.
List your team's 3 strengths and build your game around them.
During the match, stay fair: frustration often makes coaches unfair to players.
manager.src: Based on Pierre Alba, Approches du Handball no. 51

causerie.idee: A short, calm moment when only one person speaks: the coach.
texte: The pre-match meeting is there to focus the group on the game. If several adults speak, the message gets blurred.
pratique: Choose a quiet place; 10 minutes is enough.
Present the opponent: 2 strengths, 2 weaknesses.
Give the game plan and the likely difficulties.
Remind the players of your team's strengths.
Announce the line-up and justify it in a few words.
causerie.src: Based on Pierre Alba, Approches du Handball no. 51

soimeme.titre: Be yourself and build a support team
soimeme.idee: A tense coach passes his tension on to the team. Be yourself, hold your course and rely on your staff.
texte: The coach must be a stable reference point. If he plays a role that isn't his own, he loses effectiveness and the group senses it.
Nobody can do everything alone: assistant, physio, club official… each brings their skills, and information must flow.
pratique: Take 5 minutes before the match to bring your own tension down.
Set your standards, explain them, then stick to them.
Check in regularly with your assistant or a parent representative.
soimeme.src: Based on an interview about mental training, Approches du Handball no. 65

lire.titre: Helping young players read the game
lire.idee: Playing is not enough: the coach must help the child spot the useful information.
texte: The game is the basis of development. But putting children in matches without helping them build reference points leaves them drowning in information.
They need to learn to be selective: look at the goal first, then the defender, then the free teammate.
pratique: Give one reference point at a time: “look at the goalkeeper before you shoot”.
Stop play for 20 seconds to get players to describe a situation.
Ask questions rather than giving the answer.
lire.src: Based on Claude Onesta, Approches du Handball no. 68

passes.idee: The pass to create an overload, the pass to the line player, the pass on a cross: top-level skills you can start working on from 10-11 years old, through play.
texte: Handball is a sport where players mature late. But some technical skills are worth learning early, in a playful way, especially for the most motivated youngsters.
pratique: Slip a bonus rule into your games: a goal after a pass to the line player counts double.
Work on passing into the teammate's run, not into standing hands.
Hold contests of accurate passing on the move.
passes.src: Based on Olivier Krumbholz, Approches du Handball no. 68

minihand.idee: Small courts, small teams: every child touches the ball more often and improves faster.
texte: Mini-handball is played with natural movements and is fun straight away. It also develops cooperation, decision-making and a sense of responsibility.
With three courts across the width of a full court, six teams play at the same time.
pratique: Make teams of similar level so everyone has a chance.
Rotate roles: referee, scorer, timekeeper.
Apply the rules loosely at first, then more and more precisely.
minihand.src: Based on a feature on mini-handball, Approches du Handball no. 34

ados.idee: A changing body, a desire for freedom, a need to find themselves: teenagers need a suitable offer, not a copy-paste of senior training.
texte: At this age, growth upsets reference points and coordination. Failures can be discouraging. Teenagers like to push themselves and win, but reject constraints that are too heavy.
Applying senior methods as they are is a common cause of dropping out.
pratique: Offer freer formats from time to time (tournaments, 3 against 3, beach handball).
Explain why you ask for things, rather than imposing them.
Reassure players bothered by their growth: it will pass.
ados.src: Based on Roger Flament, Approches du Handball no. 51

acteur.titre: Make the player an active learner
acteur.idee: A drill that is too directed produces followers. Let the player search for and discover the solution.
texte: Many coaches think they offer learning situations, but their instructions and corrections turn them into mere repetition.
Repetition is still needed to make things automatic, but repeating is not doing exactly the same again: you vary the constraints.
pratique: Start a drill without announcing the objective, then ask the players to find it.
Change only one constraint at a time (space, numbers, time).
Allow 2 minutes of searching before correcting.
acteur.src: Based on trainees on the coach education course, Approches du Handball no. 87

placelecture.titre: Set play or reading the game?
placelecture.idee: Set play relies on learned systems. Reading the game lets each player take the initiative, within shared principles.
texte: Set play prepares positions according to the opposing defence (for example two line players against a 5-1). It needs maximum space and wide, fast ball circulation.

Reading the game rests on shared principles: width, looking at the goal, receiving on the run, refilling vacated positions. The two combine: you can start by reading the game, then go into a set move.
pratique: Learn 2 or 3 simple systems, not ten.
Also work on the general principles in free play.
In a match, leave room for initiative before calling a set play.
placelecture.src: Based on Daniel Costantini, Approches du Handball no. 87

vitesse.idee: At the highest level, a team can have more than 60 possessions per match: set attacks are short and transitions decisive.
texte: Observations of major competitions show many possessions and attacks of less than 30 seconds. Teams that defend high win more balls and exploit them with fast play.
pratique: Build transition (attack-defence and defence-attack) into almost every session.
Count the balls won and what your team does with them.
Practise the quick throw-off after conceding a goal.
vitesse.src: Based on Olivier De La Fuente and Pierre Mangin, Approches du Handball no. 79

echauffement.titre: The warm-up prepares the mind too
echauffement.idee: Warming up means going from rest to being ready for the theme of the day, physically and mentally.
texte: The warm-up raises heart rate, breathing and muscle temperature. It improves coordination and protects against injury.
It should also get players into the session's theme: you don't warm up the same way for speed work or for defence.
pratique: Build your warm-up after choosing the session's theme.
End it with a movement close to the main drill.
Add a moment of focus: instruction, goal for the day.
echauffement.src: Based on Thierry Anti, Approches du Handball no. 96

blessures.idee: Handball is one of the sports with the most injuries. 10 to 15 minutes of strengthening and balance work clearly reduce the risk.
texte: The most affected areas are the shoulder, ankle, knee and back. Regular muscle strengthening and proprioception (balance) work protects them.
These routines can be done with just a ball. Do them at almost every session during the August and January restarts.
pratique: Shoulders: rotations with a band, core work leaning on a ball.
Ankles and knees: balance on one leg, cushioned jump landings.
At least once a week for recreational players, more often for competitive ones.
blessures.src: Based on an injury prevention programme, Approches du Handball no. 106

planifier.idee: The same workload every week leads to overtraining. Alternate hard weeks and lighter weeks.
texte: Coaching means anticipating. Physical preparation is planned around the fixture list: periods with a main physical theme, loading weeks and recovery weeks.
The question to keep asking: does what I work on physically show up in the game?
pratique: Identify the season's important matches and organise your load around them.
After 2 or 3 intense weeks, plan a lighter week.
Prefer physical exercises with a ball, close to the game.
planifier.src: Based on Approches du Handball no. 77
